reviews.text: The service was quick; the technician was immediately available to help and answer any questions.

Once again, I want to thank the team at this veterinary clinic for their excellent treatment. We took my Max there on Monday the 30th, arriving at 10 am without an appointment, and they had no problem attending to us. And not only attending to us, but doing so with all the care in the world... helping us, explaining things, treating my Max like a king and making us feel at home. I recommend this clinic to everyone, you won't be disappointed. Max is better and sends you both a couple of licks. Thank you!!!
